issue_title: [Enhancement] 添加 __eq__ 和 __hash__ 方法支持 Todo 对象比较和去重
implementation_summary: Added __eq__ method to compare Todo objects by id and __hash__ method to enable set/dict usage. Changed @dataclass decorator to use eq=False to prevent default field-based equality.
approach: Implemented id-based equality and hashing for Todo dataclass, allowing objects with same id to be considered equal and enabling use in sets/dicts.
